system.flavor:
Call out the route through rubble, a packed market, a smoking hallway, or a scree slope, and the people who follow it move clean. Take the first steps yourself to show it is safe.

Not enough to clear the way or guide people you cannot see or shout to.

body.label: Target
body.html: A visible line of 3 spaces beginning within 2 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Mark a route until the start of your next turn. Willing creatures moving along it ignore the first difficult space of that movement; you may move 1 unit along it immediately.

surges.html: One willing creature within 2 units of the route becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Standard
rider.html: Spend this Authority when an enemy declares a ranged Action at a creature on the route before your next turn: that target gains +1 Fortitude against the Action.
